messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — I'm dropping the consolidated action list here so we can track owners and deadlines. TL;DR: timeouts, partial responses, and reconnect logic need short-term patches + a medium-term test/observability sprint.

elaine: Actions (short):
1) Add server-side hard timeout + graceful close (owner: @sam)
2) Client reconnect backoff refinement (owner: @karl)
3) Detect/alert on partial response rates > 0.5% (owner: @priya)
4) E2E flaky test repro harness + nightly job (owner: @natalie)
5) Postmortem doc + runbook updates (owner: @elaine)

karl: I'll take the client reconnect changes. Plan: implement jittered exponential backoff, avoid immediate reconnect storms, and add a circuit-breaker flag. ETA: EOD Wed.

priya: For alerting I'll add a ratio metric: partial_responses / total_streams. Suggest alert at 0.2% P1 for high-traffic customers, 0.5% for global. Will also add a dashboard. ETA: Thurs morning.

sam: Taking server-side timeout guard. Proposal: if stream idle for 10s w/o tokens, send "end-of-stream" and close. Also add a 30s absolute hard cap. I'll open PR with config flags so Dedicated customers can tune. ETA: 2 days.

natalie: Re: E2E harness — I'll add a small harness that simulates network glitches and client disconnects. Will run in CI nightly and fail on regressions. Also will add a reproducer script:
```bash
# simulate flaky client
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream || true
```
I'll attach the repro to the postmortem doc. ETA: Fri.

oncall-bot: Incident summary posted to /incidents channel and linked in the postmortem doc. Incident ID: INC-2026-042. Partial_response spikes at 14:03 UTC, 14:18 UTC.

elaine: Small ops notes: add a synthetic check that streams 1 token/sec for 60s and ensures no partial frames. We should run this from three regions. @priya can we surface region breakdown on the dashboard?

priya: Yep — will add region and model filters. Also adding per-client-id aggregations so we can spot noisy customers.

karl: On the client side I'll avoid reconnecting when HTTP status is 429 or 500 unless backoff threshold reached. For 499/closed-by-client we'll attempt a single immediate reconnect. Will document behavior in SDK CHANGELOG.

sam: From infra perspective, observed pattern: spikes coincide with autoscaled bursts where queued requests increase 2x. We should consider a short-lived grace pool to absorb spikes or route to lower-capacity models. Putting this on the Optimize backlog but short-term I'll add a fallback route to coil-model-small to keep UX intact.

elaine: Ownership & timeline recap (please confirm if these are accurate):
- sam: server timeout + fallback route PR by +2 days
- karl: client reconnect refinements by EOD Wed
- priya: dashboard/alerts by Thurs morning
- natalie: E2E harness + repro by Fri
- elaine: runbook + postmortem updates by next Mon

natalie: Confirmed. I'll also add a nightly job to run the harness and create a GitHub issue automatically if failure rate > 0.1%.

karl: Small test snippet I'll add to SDK tests:
```js
// simulate mid-stream disconnect
await streamClient.open();
await streamClient.send('prompt');
await simulateNetworkCut();
expect(await streamClient.reconnect()).toBe(true);
```

priya: Quick question — do we want an automated rollback if partial response rate spikes after deploy? Could hook into release bot.

elaine: Good idea. Let's add an auto-fallback policy for new model rollouts: if partial_responses > 0.3% in the first 30 minutes, automatically route new traffic to previous stable variant and notify oncall. @sam can you add a knob in routing?

sam: Yep. I'll add a rollout guard and a dry-run mode so we can validate behavior without flipping traffic.

elaine: One-off: @karl please add a small onboarding note for SDK users about recommended client reconnection patterns. That should reduce user-induced issues.

oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly reliability sync on Thursdays 16:00 UTC. Adding this thread as agenda item: "streaming partial response remediation status".

sam: I'll post the PR links here when ready.

karl: Will do.

elaine: Thanks everyone — updating the postmortem doc with these owners now and will ping again for any blockers. :spiral_calendar:
